summary: Reactive Resume is a self-hosted application designed for creating and exporting personal CVs and resumes. It places a strong emphasis on user privacy, allowing you to manage your career documents locally without relying on third-party cloud services.
goodFor: It suits individuals who want absolute control over their personal data and prefer to generate professionally styled resumes in a secure, self-managed environment.
watchOut: You will need to handle your own data backups and ensure proper access controls if you expose the instance to the wider internet.
deployNotes: Deployment typically involves running a Docker container, and you will usually need to configure persistent storage for user data alongside a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
